name: Mochi
notes: A round strawberry mochi, built from primitives in character.js (no model to download). The 15-second show is the shared templates/_acts/showtime.js: pop out of the card, hello, a lap round the card, a squishy dance, a somersault roll, cheering with confetti cannons and fireworks while the board with the card's words comes up, then the letter rises. One stop: a tap opens the letter.
